_SURFACE_RATE_FACTORS_comment: Per-surface multipliers on the gamma/neutron surface rates (lib/weights.py normalize_true_weights), lateral only, so lateral follows the centralAPA convention without changing central. (1) normalize_true_weights divides each surface by the total generated events instead of those generated on that surface, so every surface rate carries its generation share f_s (surface_production.json): 0.25 central, 0.2 lateral. 0.25/0.2 = 1.25 puts lateral on the central scale. (2) surface_areas.json 'hd' surface 0 is one side wall (1250x1445) but get_detector_mass doubles the lateral mass for the two lateral TPCs, so the wall needs another x2. Remove this when the per-surface N_gen normalization is fixed for all configs.
